name: Animated reel
summary: Marketing-team-idea → AI-generated scenes → MP4 in every chosen platform format. Use this pillar for any short-form video; the brief + the animate skill handle the rest.

voice_rules: name numbers and people the way they should be said
put the payoff hit in a pause before the line that names it

extra_voice_rules: Hook in the first 2 seconds. The cover is a question, not a statement.
Each content slide is one beat. Don't try to fit more than one idea per slide.
The CTA is a verb: 'Save this', 'Comment X', 'Tap the link in bio'.
extra_checks: Every fact on a content slide appears in the brief's `idea` text — no hallucinated numbers.
Hook is the cover's headline (no separate 'hook' slide).
